scenario: [LTIM.4.1.1] / [LTIM.5.1] (LTIM.12.12, the id, is a tombstone): `Time - Time` is a `Duration`, and `<` is defined for `Duration`, so `(now() - e.fired_at) < 5_min` compiles. What the subtraction computes, saturation included, is logical/LTIM.4.1.1_*'s.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule r:
    Event e where (now() - e.fired_at) < 5_min
->
    log info "recent event"
